# Test fixtures

`rancho.json` is a snapshot (October 2026) of what the app fetches for Rancho San Antonio, near
Cupertino, California: iNaturalist species counts for October within 3 km (observation data
CC BY-NC, see inaturalist.org) and the "Description" sections of the species' English Wikipedia
articles (text CC BY-SA 4.0, see each article's history for authors).
